notes.claim: When converting between metric units of area and volume, the numbers to multiply or divide by are squared for area and cubed for volume.
A cable maker states conductor size as a cross-section in mm², and IEC 60228 is the standard that sets the nominal cross-sectional areas of conductors.
The MCA General Engineering Science I syllabus includes the area of an annulus and the mass of an object from its volume and density.

sources.title: IEC 60228:2023 | IEC
sources.quote: IEC 60228:2023 specifies the nominal cross-sectional areas, in the range 0,5 mm2 to 3 500 mm2, for conductors in electric power cables and cords of a wide range of types.
